errors.text_span: The chart is divided into ten slices
errors.evidence: The chart is a sunburst/donut chart with multiple rings (layers), not a simple pie chart with ten slices. It has an inner ring showing layers (Perception Layer 40.4%, Semantic Layer 41.2%, Cultural Layer 14.1%, Signal Layer 4.3%) and an outer ring showing subcategories.
The 4.3% corresponds to 'Signal Layer' in the inner ring, not 'Acoustic Quality Analysis'. Acoustic Quality Analysis is a subcategory shown in the outer ring without a percentage label.
The label in the figure reads 'Emotion & Intention', not 'Emotion & Perception'.
The figure shows Semantic Layer as 41.2%, which is correct, but this belongs to the inner ring layer structure, not to the outer slice categories listed. The description conflates the two rings.

The chart is a sunburst/donut chart with two concentric rings: an inner ring showing four layers (Perception Layer 40.4%, Semantic Layer 41.2%, Cultural Layer 14.1%, Signal Layer 4.3%) and an outer ring with subcategories. The description fails to mention the Perception Layer (40.4%) which is clearly labeled in the inner ring.

The description omits several outer ring categories visible in the figure, including: Aesthetic Analysis, Culture of Speaker, Imagination, Anomaly/Detection, Audio Difference Analysis, and Content Analysis as a major outer segment.

errors.text_span: A legend is present to the upper left of the chart, labeling each category with its corresponding color
errors.evidence: There is no legend in the figure. The labels are directly annotated on or near the chart segments, not in a separate legend box.
The description does not clearly convey that this is a hierarchical sunburst chart showing a task taxonomy with an inner layer structure and outer subcategory structure.
